{{Quote|We have a ship down. We lost a Destroyer.|A First Order officer, in regards to the ''Sutta''|<ref name="Date" />}}
The '''''Sutta''''' was a [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], that was [[Commanding officer|helmed]] by [[Captain]] [[Strok]] in [[35 ABY]]. The ''Sutta'' and the other [[Starship|vessels]] of the fleet were activated on the [[Sith]] [[planet]] [[Exegol]] on the direct command of [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]]. After the ''[[Derriphan]]'' briefly left Exegol and [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] the planet [[Kijimi]], the [[Resistance]], led by [[General]]s [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Finn]], launched an [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] on the Sith fleet and the [[First Order]] [[flagship]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']].

The ''Sutta'', like other vessels in the fleet, attacked Resistance forces, until the [[Citizens' Fleet]] arrived to reinforce the Resistance and defeat the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]]. The ''Sutta'' was the first [[Star Destroyer]] targeted and, following the destruction of its [[axial superlaser]], was destroyed by multiple explosions that obliterated it.

==Description==
[[File:Sutta-cannon-destroyed.png|thumb|left|240px|The ''Sutta''{{'s}} main armament is targeted by the Resistance.]]
The ''Sutta'' was a [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="Battles" /> that was manufactured by [[Kuat-Entralla Drive Yards]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> As a ''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer, the ''Sutta'' was 2,406 [[meter]]s in length and 682 meters in height.<ref name="TROS VD note" /> It was based on an upscaled version of the old [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> and as such featured two [[deflector shield generator dome]]s on top of the [[Starship|ship's]] [[conning tower]]<ref name="TROS VD note" /> where the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] was situated.<ref name="TROS VD" />

The ''Sutta'' was armed with an [[axial superlaser]]<ref name="Episode IX" /> that was capable of destroying entire [[planet]]s through [[orbital bombardment]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> and was fed directly from the ventral [[solar ionization reactor]]. It also featured [[Hangar|launch bays]] adjacent to the [[superlaser]],<ref name="TROS VD note" /> as well as seven [[ion engine]]s and a [[hyperdrive]]. Like all other [[Sith]] [[Star Destroyer]]s, the ''Sutta'' featured the [[Color|red]] lines of the [[Sith Eternal]] [[Religion|cult]] on its [[hull]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==History==
{{Quote|Just… shoot stuff! Uh, I mean, hit those underbelly cannons with all you've got. Every one we knock out is a world saved.|Poe Dameron, to his allies as they target the ''Sutta''|<ref name="TROS EE">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Xyston-engines.png|thumb|300px|right|The ''Sutta'' was one of over a thousand Sith Star Destroyers on Exegol.]]
Like the other Star Destroyers of the Sith Eternal's [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], the ''Sutta'' was secretly manufactured by Kuat-Entralla Drive Yards in the [[shipyard]] forges in the [[Forbidden District]] below the surface of the Sith planet [[Exegol]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> and was eventually placed under the [[Commanding officer|command]] of [[Captain]] [[Strok]].<ref name="Battles" /> The ''Sutta'', and other Sith Star Destroyers of the Final Order, were under the direct control of the leader of the Sith Eternal, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]]. Following the arrival of [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], the [[Supreme Leader]] of the [[First Order]], to the [[Sith Citadel]] on Exegol and his encounter with the Dark Lord<ref name="Episode IX" /> in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the entire 1,080 Star Destroyers<ref name="BBC Click">{{YouTube|video=bDa5h3cj1DU|text=Star Wars: How We Brought Carrie Fisher Back: Inside The VFX|channel=@BBCClick|name=BBC Click}}</ref> of the Sith armada broke through the surface of the planet, poised to leave Exegol and conquer [[the galaxy]]. One ship of the armada, the ''[[Derriphan]]'', was briefly sent out to the wider [[galaxy]] and [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] the planet [[Kijimi]] before it returned to Exegol. Afterward, Sidious's [[Palpatine family|granddaughter]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] arrived on Exegol to confront the [[Sith Lord]]. Under the joint leadership of [[General]]s [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Finn]], the [[Resistance]], which had been engaged in a [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the First Order, followed Rey to the Sith world and attacked the Sith fleet, beginning the [[Battle of Exegol]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

Initially arriving to destroy the [[navigation tower]] on the surface of Exegol to prevent the launch of the Final Order fleet, the Resistance [[starfighter]]s were met with a barrage of [[laser]] fire from the Sith Star Destroyers before being confronted by [[TIE/dg starfighter]]s. After the tower was deactivated and the signal transferred to the First Order [[flagship]], the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], the Resistance fighters became overwhelmed by the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]]. [[Exegol landing team|Resistance soldiers]] onboard the hull of the ''Steadfast'' attempted to disrupt the signal, which they momentarily succeeded. As Resistance forces dwindled, General [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] arrived with the [[light freighter]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' at the forefront of the [[Citizens' Fleet]], an expansive<ref name="Episode IX" /> 14,000-strong<ref name="The Escape Bucket List">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-escape-part-2-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 5 Fun Facts from "The Escape - Part 2" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}</ref> allied fleet from all parts of the galaxy. With the new reinforcements, Dameron ordered the others to focus on the superlasers of the Star Destroyers.<ref name="Episode IX" />

[[File:Sutta-destroyed.png|thumb|left|285px|The ''Sutta'' is completely destroyed.]]
Subsequently, the ''Sutta'' was the first Sith Star Destroyer targeted by Resistance and allied forces.<ref name="Episode IX" /> The ''Falcon'',<ref name="TROS EE" /> [[RZ-2 A-wing interceptor]]s, [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]s, and a [[B-wing Mark III]] focused their fire on the ''Sutta''{{'s}} underbelly axial superlaser, resulting in a chain reaction of explosions from the [[cannon]] to the [[reactor]]. Following the detonation of the reactor, more explosions tore through the midship and engulfed the command structure in front of the tower. More explosions followed, and the ''Sutta'' was consumed by the destruction. Following the loss of the ''Sutta'', a crew member aboard the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} bridge announced that they had lost a Destroyer. The other Sith Star Destroyers eventually followed the ''Sutta'' in destruction, with the Resistance and its allies emerging victorious from the battle, which witnessed the complete destruction of the Sith forces and [[Darth]] Sidious.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Sutta'', like the other Sith Star Destroyers of the Final Order, was under the overall command of [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]] under the direction of Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious,<ref name="Episode IX" /> with Captain Strok serving as the commanding [[Sith Eternal officer|officer]] of the ship while at Exegol.<ref name="Battles" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Sutta'' first appeared in the final film of the [[Star Wars saga|''Star Wars'' saga]], [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], which was released in [[2019]].<ref name="Episode IX" /> Its name was revealed in the [[2021]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''.<ref name="Battles" /> In the functioning [[Sith (language)|Sith language]] created by [[Ben Grossblatt]] for the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', ''sutta'' means "[[spear]]."<ref name="Grossblatt e-mail">{{EmailCite|email=Wookieepedia:Email/Ben Grossblatt|creator=[[Ben Grossblatt]]|date=2012-07-16}}</ref>
